title_draft: Zad Archery Beginner Guide: Current Progression After the Mega Update
quick_answer_draft: After the September 4 Mega Update, a current Zad Archery run moves from early wave clearing into Jobs and Preferred Job, then Symbols, then Portal Currency and Rings after level 30, and finally Endless once the Level 50 cap is gone. Learn each system as it unlocks; do not treat unverified Symbol or Ring rankings as required beginner advice.

sections.h2: What kind of game is Zad Archery?

claims.text: The core loop is still clearing target-like enemies, taking loot, and reinvesting into upgrades and skills.
Steam tags the game as Incremental, Idler, Loot, Platformer, Roguelite, RPG, Strategy, Crafting and Mining.

sections.h2: Current progression path after the Mega Update

claims.text: Early progression still starts with wave clearing, loot, the skill tree, and unlocking systems such as crafting and mining.
Jobs remain a core growth axis; the Mega Update adds Preferred Job, which doubles all bonuses of the preferred job.
The Symbol System adds 50+ Symbols and Exalted Symbols as a post-job growth layer.
After level 30, Portal Currency feeds the Ring System, which includes 9 Ring perks.
Endless farming is available after the Level 50 cap was removed.

sections.h2: What not to invent while learning the systems

claims.text: Public official notes confirm the systems exist, but they do not publish a verified best-Symbol ranking, complete Ring ranking, or exact hidden values.
September 5 Patch 1.1.1 is the current follow-up patch after the Mega Update and includes Guardian / skipped-level recovery fixes.

faq.q: What should I unlock first after the Mega Update?
faq.a: Follow the verified order: early progression systems, Jobs / Preferred Job, Symbols, then Portal Currency and Rings after level 30, then Endless. Exact best picks inside those systems are not published in the official notes used here.

faq.q: How many jobs are in Zad Archery?
faq.a: The official Steam description still lists five Archer Jobs. Preferred Job is a Mega Update addition that doubles the preferred job's bonuses.

codex_rule: Map evidence into existing V4 Guide Content Result. Do not invent Symbol/Ring rankings or hidden values.
